title: Wrapped lines run one character over the limit
statement: `go test ./...` fails: the help-text wrapper sometimes emits a line one character wider than the width it was given. Track it down and fix it.
notes: Needs the Go toolchain only. An off-by-one the statement describes by symptom only: the separating space is not counted when deciding whether the next word fits. The failing property test sweeps widths 5 to 20, so a fix that special-cases one width does not pass, and Indent and Longest are covered so a rewrite of the file has to keep them.
